_about: Module definitions for the support group (A3 survivors of the cut: Lab, Lamp; A5: Shorer). See logistics.json for the shape. `tech` names the research that opens it for the Build list.

modules.name: Lab
modules.blurb: Turns power from the Hub's stockpile into progress on the tech picked in the Research tab (T), and takes the goods that tech wants out of it too. Each Lab adds up to 2 power/s. Needs a Node or the Hub within reach.

modules.name: Lamp
modules.blurb: Lights 200 cells round it while it has power (0.1/s from the Hub's stockpile; it needs a Node or the Hub within reach). Rock casts shadows.

modules.name: Shorer
modules.blurb: Lays its own supports. Powder a Tank passes into its bottom face (Rubble, Loose dirt, Sand) is set, a cell for a cell, into the open air in a strip along its left side as the rock it presses to: Rubble becomes Stone. It never displaces liquid or ground. Hung on a rig beside the shaft wall it lines the gap behind the rig with the spoil the Cutter digs. R turns it before placing. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and a little power a cell.
